notes: NPC-TRADE-SELLALL-1 keeps its existing command 97 SELL_ALL shape: at most 20 whole item BURNs and 3 coin MINTs. E12 explicitly maps the same existing owner’s closed Hireling SELL shape to this resource group: the current named House, active Hireling and source offer are proved before mutation; one item BURN and at most eight physical coin MINTs pay at most 5,400,000 gold. The single-item Hireling shape uses at most nine touched items, nine custody lines, nine participants and nineteen work units, within the unchanged 23/23/23/66 ceilings. The byte rows also bound admitted named-House BUY and imbuement-package payloads with optional house_key field 17; the exact encoded payload/envelope is checked before any write. Oversized worst cases fail closed. Ordinary Channel BUY/SELL retain their original shape-specific limits. See ../protocol-oteryn/v1/hireling-trade-and-audit-v1.md for the explicit mapping and source evidence.
